EmailTemplate.subject: Al Kanz | Update Relatives Information
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Al Kanz | Update Relatives Information
Attn: All Staff
As you are aware, staff and their immediate relatives are not eligible to participate in any ila Bank prize draws such as Al Kanz draws, or any other raffles with prizes.
This is a kind reminder to review and update the list of your "immediate relatives”. If you have already submitted this information, please take a moment to review the information provided previously to ensure it is still valid (if the information is outdated, we would appreciate if you could kindly update it).
If you have no relatives to report, kindly select this option on the form. Please use this link to complete or update the information.
Kindly note that “immediate relatives” are classified as Mother, Father, Spouse, Daughter, Son, Granddaughter and Grandson.
It is worth noting that you will be required to provide:
The mobile number your relatives used when opening ila Bank Accounts The CPR number of the relative The nature of your relationship
If any of the “immediate relatives“ you declared hold an ila Bank account, we will notify them that they are no longer eligible for prize draws as a result of your declaration.
Immediate relatives below the age of 18 do not need to be added to the list. However, you are kindly requested to update the list when they turn 18.
Please note that the information you provide will be managed strictly in accordance with the Privacy Policy
If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact ammar.abdulrahman@ilabank.com in ila business team.
Best regards, ila Bank Team
Bank ABC Tower, Head Office, P.O Box: 5698, Manama, Kingdom of Bahrain
If you have received this message in error, please notify our contact center of the error and delete the message.
Licensed as a Conventional Retail Bank – Branch by the Central Bank of Bahrain
